items.question: What is a Bali Moon Facial?
items.answer: The Bali Moon Facial is Spa Bali Moon's signature 1-hour facial in Seminyak, Bali, to cleanse, refresh and nourish the skin. It combines cleansing, steam, exfoliation, an argan oil lymphatic facial massage and a mask chosen for your skin: Tea Tree or Gold.

items.question: Can a facial help after spending time in the Bali sun?
items.answer: Yes, for skin that feels dry or tired after a day in the sun: a Bali Moon Facial at Spa Bali Moon cleanses the skin, restores moisture and leaves your complexion refreshed, and the Gold Facial focuses on hydration. If your skin is sunburnt, book our aloe vera sunburn treatment instead.

items.question: What are the benefits of a Bali Moon Facial?
items.answer: A Bali Moon Facial can help cleanse the skin, remove surface impurities, improve hydration and leave the skin feeling refreshed. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, the Tea Tree mask helps balance excess oil and calm blemishes, while the Gold mask focuses on hydration, elasticity and a healthy-looking glow.

items.question: Where can I get a Bali Moon Facial in Seminyak?
items.answer: You can get a Bali Moon Facial at Spa Bali Moon, Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, Bali, open daily from 9am to 11pm. Our therapists can also come to your villa or hotel for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: How much does a facial cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: The Bali Moon Tea Tree Facial is IDR 196.000 and the Bali Moon Gold Facial is IDR 269.000 per person at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak. Four facial packages from IDR 439.000 per person add a massage, some with a body scrub or cream bath. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Which facial is right for my skin?
items.answer: At Spa Bali Moon, choose the Tea Tree Facial (IDR 196.000 per person) for oily, congested or blemish-prone skin, and the Gold Facial (IDR 269.000 per person) for dry, dehydrated or dull skin, or skin that feels tired after sun. For combination skin, tell your therapist how it feels and we'll suggest one.

items.question: What happens during the Bali Moon Facial?
items.answer: The Bali Moon Facial at Spa Bali Moon follows six steps: a milk cleanser to remove surface buildup, warm steam to soften and prepare the pores, a red clay scrub for gentle exfoliation, an argan oil lymphatic facial massage, a Tea Tree or Gold mask chosen for your skin, and a rose water toner to finish.

items.question: How long does a facial take?
items.answer: A facial at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 1 hour, on its own or as part of a spa package: IDR 196.000 for the Tea Tree Facial and IDR 269.000 for the Gold Facial, per person.

items.question: Can I have a facial at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen and everything a facial needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book a facial for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my facial?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your facial on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
